title: Stillwater Civic Briefing
author: Stillwater Civic Briefing
description: Two episodes a week. Monday is the week's public events. Wednesday is a short account of one person who holds an office in the St. Croix valley. Stillwater, Lake Elmo, Oakdale, Woodbury, Bayport, Oak Park Heights, Hudson, Washington County, and the Stillwater-area and Oakdale-area schools. Researched and written by AI from public records. Not a substitute for the official record. Charges are allegations, not convictions. Verify against the source links.
